scope: offline provenance repair only; no new GitHub Search, README or candidate-page requests
supersedes: v1 offline replay/probe instrumentation claims; original live result stays historical with missing contemporaneous guard binding
launch_requirements: Use a detached verifier worktree at the protocol freeze commit; load its tracked preload by absolute path
Before each process: compare file SHA-256 and Git blob to this protocol and the committed object; fail before launch on mismatch
After each process: repeat guard and protocol digest checks and record both digests, freeze commit, argv, exits and metrics
Run only the existing native CLI replay and five offline probes against retained captures; no real discovery rerun
Verify the guard is active with one blocked fetch and one blocked https.request canary; do not label canary attempts as zero
Rebuild the unchanged main source offline before replay; record build exit and CLI byte hash
historical_limit: No retrospective checksum can prove which preload executed the original live run. Current snapshot equality is not contemporaneous execution attestation. No new live run is authorized by this protocol.
